title: DPWH: Pasig Blvd-C5 Flyover, C5 Boni Serrano Flyover to be reopened ahead of schedule

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Motorists can already access the Pasig Boulevard-C5 Flyover and C5 Boni Serrano Flyover earlier than their originally scheduled completion, the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) announced on Sunday. In a statement, the DPWH said the northbound lane of the Pasig Blvd-C5 Flyover will be passable early on Monday evening, November 2, while its southbound lane will stick to its reopening schedule on Tuesday, Nov. 3. The DPWH also noted that the C5 Boni Serrano Flyover will reopen by Monday evening. Repair work on the two flyovers was originally scheduled for completion on Tuesday morning. The agency […]...
